requirements.quote: Also tidy up the host: delete the `/mnt/volume/falcon` directory and everything inside it.
Do not write anything else to `validation.log`.
Save the result to `/home/user/release/release_summary.csv`, ending with a newline.

check.cmd: python3 -c "import json,re,sys;d=json.load(open('/home/user/release/env_descriptor.json'));S=d['services'];L=open('/home/user/release/release_summary.csv').read().split('\n');ok=L[-1]=='' and len(L)-1==len(S);ok=ok and all(l and l.count(',')==1 and ' ' not in l for l in L[:-1]);vals=lambda s:[str(v) for v in s.values()] if isinstance(s,dict) else [str(s)];ok=ok and all(l.split(',')[0] in vals(s) and all(p in json.dumps(s) for p in re.split('[:@]',l.split(',')[1]) if p) for l,s in zip(L[:-1],S));sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

requirements.quote: No additional files may be created in `/home/user/release` except the two specified outputs.
The log and CSV must be created with filesystem permissions 0644 or more permissive (they just need to be readable).

check.cmd: for f in /home/user/release/validation.log /home/user/release/release_summary.csv; do p=$(stat -c %a "$f") || exit 1; [ $(( 0$p & 0644 )) -eq $(( 0644 )) ] || exit 1; done

requirements.quote: Do not modify the original `env_schema.json` or `env_descriptor.json`.
